name: CIWA-Ar
description: Clinical Institute Withdrawal Assessment for Alcohol
template:
CIWA-Ar (Alcohol Withdrawal Assessment)

Quantifies severity of alcohol withdrawal syndrome

Original: Sullivan JT et al. Br J Addict 1989
Score Range: 0-67
Management:
• <8: Minimal/absent withdrawal - supportive care
• 8-15: Mild-moderate withdrawal - consider pharmacotherapy
• >15: Severe withdrawal - pharmacotherapy indicated
Treatment: Benzodiazepines (chlordiazepoxide, diazepam, lorazepam)
Monitoring: Reassess every 1-4 hours based on severity
